name: PianoGlass AltStore Source
subtitle: Halbestunde-style piano sheet music scanner & interactive player
description: Scan printed or digital piano sheet music, recognize notation with Optical Music Recognition (OMR), and play along with real-time polyphonic piano audio, animated score, illuminated keyboard, and practice tools enclosed in a Liquid Glass UI.

apps.name: PianoGlass
apps.versionDescription:
Initial v1.0.0 Release:
• Liquid Glass (Glassmorphism) UI with .ultraThinMaterial and specular rim glows
• Camera sheet music scanner with Optical Music Recognition (OMR)
• Physical modeling polyphonic acoustic grand piano audio engine
• Interactive score canvas with synchronized animated playhead
• 61/88-key lighted virtual piano keyboard with dual-hand color cues
• Practice suite: A-B looping, tempo slider (40-240 BPM), transposition, LH/RH isolation
• Preloaded classical repertoire (Für Elise, Moonlight Sonata, Minuet in G, Chopin Nocturne)
apps.localizedDescription: PianoGlass turns your sheet music into an interactive piano coach. Snap a photo of any piano sheet music to immediately hear it played, follow along note-by-note on an illuminated virtual keyboard, slow down the tempo, isolate left or right hand, and loop difficult passages.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: PianoGlass requires camera access to scan piano sheet music.
